meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会对比当前代码和已发布的 npm 包版本，梳理所有未发布的改动，按组件类别（核心组件、opencode、codex）分类，并给出每个类别的版本号提升建议。它会阅读实际代码差异，而非只看提交说明。
howto.when: 当用户提到“未发布的改动”“changelog”“what changed”等关键词，或要求查看版本变化时触发。

say.text: 查看一下有哪些未发布的改动。
say.note: Claude 会比较当前代码与已发布版本。

say.text: 按发布层列出所有未发布的更改。
say.note: 会按核心组件、opencode、codex 分类。

say.text: 分析最新提交并给出版本号提升建议。

howto.what_en: Claude compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, lists all unpublished changes, classifies them by release layer, and recommends version bumps. It reads actual diffs rather than commit messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', etc., or asks to review version changes.

say_en.note: Claude compares HEAD with published versions.
Categorized by core components, opencode, codex.

say_en.text: Analyze recent commits and recommend version bumps.
say_en.note: Claude runs git diff and suggests semver.
